source: Summaries of retained tool-call transcripts; complete raw logs were not saved for these initial exploratory runs.

attempts.cause: Missing receipt declaration support; sandbox default temp/cache permissions.
New fixture receipt port lacked required authoring metadata.
Compiler rejected empty settings before receipt binding supplied the path.
Using save=True for receipts let the model-response writer overwrite receipt JSON with Approved; fixed by declaring expected files and keeping save=False.
Second-run fixture omitted required tool_runtime argument.
Second-run fixture passed a grant object where policy digest was required.
